// 负向样例（L-11d apperr_semantics_check）：errors.Is 目标为按 Code 匹配的 apperr.New 哨兵。
package sandbox

import (
	"errors"

	"github.com/polarisagi/polaris/pkg/apperr"
)

var errSelftestCodeSentinel = apperr.New(apperr.CodeInternal, "selftest sentinel")

func selftestCodeSentinel(err error) bool {
	return errors.Is(err, errSelftestCodeSentinel)
}
